scope: Devils Tower / Bear Lodge and its bare-rock apron, with the nearby historic ponderosa-log Visitor Center and its short mapped concrete approach.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The National Park Service identifies the broad almost-flat summit, about 1.5 acres, and the height of the monolith above the valley.
Above the talus, near-vertical phonolite columns make up the upper monolith.
The historic public Visitor Center was completed in 1935 with ponderosa pine logs and other local materials.
